about: test01_s1: the hero frame of process test 01, Amsterdam (docs/tests/process_test_01_amsterdam/CARD.md). One camera low in a small boat on a Jordaan canal at blue hour, facing a humped brick bridge whose arch and its paper twin close into one ring; her on the crown, leaning on the near railing, phone held out over the water; under her the twin's pages wake. Metres: X right, Y up (the water at Y 0), Z forward. Shared by the engine (src/look/test01_s1/*.tsx) and the bake (src/look/test01_s1/bake/*.py).
